noMatchesBody: Add a match in Events. Its game plan and evaluation will live here.
draftsNote: Only you see a draft. Each stays here until it’s shared or published.
topScorersNote: This season, from your published evaluations.
noGoalsYet: No goals or assists yet this season.
notInMatches: This match isn’t in your matches.
planSaveFailed: Couldn't save the plan. Check your connection and try again; everything you typed is still here.
planShareFailed: Couldn't share the plan. Check your connection and try again; everything you typed is still here.
planScheduleFailed: Couldn't schedule the plan. Check your connection and try again; everything you typed is still here.
histPublished: Evaluation published. The loop is closed.
instructionExample: e.g. Press together when their keeper has the ball
looksLikeExample: e.g. The nearest player goes at the keeper; the other two cut off the short pass.
scoutingExample: e.g. Their number 9 is quick and runs in behind. They go long when pressed.
strength_weaker_desc: Below our level. We expect to have the ball.
strength_similar_desc: Our level. It could go either way.
strength_stronger_desc: Above our level. We expect to defend more.
expectation_stretch_desc: A big ask today. A solid job is a good game.
expectation_lead_desc: We needed you to take charge.
copyLoaded: {{name}} loaded: your default for {{count}} a side.
copyNotComing_one: {{count}} player in this formation isn’t coming, so is in Not attending.
copyNotComing_other: {{count}} players in this formation aren’t coming, so are in Not attending.
copySkipped_one: {{count}} player was skipped: they left the roster, or their consent was withdrawn.
copySkipped_other: {{count}} players were skipped: they left the roster, or their consent was withdrawn.
copyChange: Change anything here; the formation itself stays as it was.
pickSlotHint: Pick a slot or a player to see their job and expectation here.
tapToSeeJob: Tap a player to see their job.
dragHint: Drag a player onto a place, or tap a place to pick who plays there. Tap a player to give them a job.
benchHint: Drag a player onto a place on the pitch, or onto Not selected to leave them out.
nobodyCanCome: Nobody can come yet. Confirm players in Squad › Availability.
notSelectedNote: Their families see “Not in the squad this week”. Each player reads your note.
nobodyLeftOut: Nobody is left out. Drag a player onto this tab, or pick Not selected in their sheet.
notAttendingNote: Their families see “Not in the squad this week”. A child whose family said they can’t make it is here until the family undoes it.
everyoneComing: Everyone is coming. Drag a player here when the group says they aren’t.
keyJob: Job, or a note for Not selected
nobodyPlaced: Nobody was placed here before kick-off.
nobodyByName: Nobody in this match's squad by that name
confirmedFirst: Confirmed players first. Anyone whose family said they can't make it can't be picked.
noLongerInSquad: This player is no longer in the match's squad.
staysNotAttending: {{name}} stays in Not attending until {{name}}'s family undoes it.
roleGroupLabel: Bench, not selected or not attending
familySeesNotInSquad: {{name}}'s family sees “Not in the squad this week”.
jobExample: e.g. Stay goal-side of their number 10 and win the second balls.
familySeesStarts: {{name}}'s family sees whether {{name}} starts or is on the bench, never the job. The expectation shows only with the published evaluation.
nobodyOnPitch: Nobody is on the pitch yet
talkedThrough: I’ve talked selection through with the players
publishFirst: Publish the match in Logistics first
scheduledBody_one: {{count}} player and their families read it from {{when}}, in the app only. What you save before then goes out with it.
scheduledBody_other: {{count}} players and their families read it from {{when}}, in the app only. What you save before then goes out with it.
onlyTheyGet: Only they and their families get the update.
anyTimeBefore: Any time before kick-off. Until then, only you see it.
evSaveFailed: Couldn't save the evaluation. Check your connection and try again; everything you entered is still here.
evPublishFailed: Couldn't publish the evaluation. Check your connection and try again; everything you entered is still here.
opensBody: The result, whether the plan worked, and each player against what you expected. Only you see it until you publish it.
publishedTo_one: Published to {{count}} player and their families. The loop is closed.
publishedTo_other: Published to {{count}} players and their families. The loop is closed.
skippedGotNothing_one: {{count}} player is no longer on your roster or waiting for a parent, so they got nothing.
skippedGotNothing_other: {{count}} players are no longer on your roster or waiting for a parent, so they got nothing.
untickHint: Untick a starter who didn’t play, and tick who came on.
nobodyRecordable: Nobody in this squad can be recorded yet.
nobodyTicked: Nobody is ticked as playing. Tick who played in Result first.
noteExample: e.g. Your runs in behind stretched them all game. Next time, look up before you cross.
changedNotes_one: {{changed}} changed from Did the job · Met · {{count}} note
changedNotes_other: {{changed}} changed from Did the job · Met · {{count}} notes
blockedPlan: Answer “Did the plan work?” for every instruction first.
blockedHomeAway: Say whether it was home or away first.
blockedPlayed: Tick who played in Result first.
nobodyWouldRead: Nobody is ticked as playing, so nobody would read it.
